verdict: Drive/dynamics safety hardening is implemented and base validation passes. Full audio quality gate is blocked by an out-of-scope OutputChain golden-metrics drift.

findings.title: Boost oversized-block guard before oversampling
findings.notes: Boost tracks prepared capacity and uses a no-allocation finite dry fallback before processSamplesUp when host blocks exceed capacity.

findings.title: Boost NaN/Inf scrub
findings.notes: Non-finite input samples are zeroed before filters, oversampling, and waveshaping. Biquad state has a non-finite reset guard.

findings.title: Noise Gate NaN/Inf scrub
findings.notes: Input scrub occurs before detector/lookahead state. Biquad, detector, lookahead, and gateGain state have finite recovery guards.

findings.title: Missing ScopedNoDenormals
findings.notes: Each listed processBlock now starts with juce::ScopedNoDenormals.

findings.title: MetalDistortion dead legacy
findings.notes: Confirmed by policy scan as LEGACY_ALIAS_ONLY, not registered, with catalog mapping to Distortion. Left untouched to avoid migration risk.
